description: From XP's connected order book of resale listings. Use when a buyer wants to browse fan listings open to offers on XP (e.g. 'what's open near me this weekend', 'open listings with active offers'), then make an offer with make_offer_on_listing or buy one outright with buy_listing_now. Filterable by event, performer, and amount. Requires auth and read:bids scope. This is the offer/negotiation surface -- for a plain buy-now at the asking price without an offer, use search_events and get_ticket_listings instead.

days.description: Only include offers created within this many days.

limit.description: Max offers to return after fetch.

max_amount_usd.description: Maximum total for the whole listing in dollars (all its tickets together), not per ticket.

min_amount_usd.description: Minimum total for the whole listing in dollars (all its tickets together), not per ticket.

sort_by.description: Sort field: created_at, event_date, amount, state, updated_at.

name: list_open_listings
title: List Open Listings
